title: Rare Villages
description: RareVillages makes villages significantly rarer than vanilla Minecraft.
body:
RareVillages makes villages much rarer, not by decreasing the chance of them spawning, but by increasing the space between them. You can use [Jacobsjo's Minecraft Datapack Map](https://map.jacobsjo.eu/) to view the difference between Vanilla Minecraft and RareVillages.

- Without RareVillages, villages will spawn 34 chunks away from each other on average, with a minimum distance of just 8 chunks. 
- With RareVillages 1.0-V1 installed, villages will spawn 100 chunks away from each other on average, with a minimum distance of 50 chunks.
- With RareVillages 1.0-V2 installed, villages will spawn 75 chunks away from each other on average, with a minimum distance of 34 chunks.

Please make sure you know which version you are downloading by checking the Versions page.

I have done some testing on Minecraft versions older than 1.21 and this datapack seems to work perfectly despite Minecraft saying that it's made for newer Minecraft versions. I havn't fully tested these versions yet so keep that in mind.
